implementationDecisions.status: native-contract inference; no current character FAQ located
implementationDecisions.rule: Record physical materials of actual declared uses, used Slash-defense Dodge and Nullification. Exclude played-out Duel/AOE Slash and AOE Dodge, and zero-material virtual uses. Equipment and delayed-trick material is eligible if the entity is actually in the discard pile at selection. Select actual discard-pile entity color; owner-local suit transformations do not persist outside their zone. Native actor replacements rebase the final actual user through the exact owning use/action and typed producer event chain. The initial used-material invoice and physical provider remain unchanged; distinct response action IDs do not inherit parent actor replacement.

implementationDecisions.status: literal up-to-two inference; no current FAQ located
implementationDecisions.rule: The user expressly selects red or black before choosing zero, one or two cards. Zero is legal and issues the opposite-color promise. The later optional return may also select zero. The 2023 last-used-card rule is not consulted.

Bind the promise to the first subsequent actual native Ending phase token of its recipient. Face-down skipped turns do not enter Ending and do not consume it. Extra Draw/Play and phase restoration do not manufacture an Ending. Outstanding source-instance/hash promises survive skill loss; an already-paid gain drains real children. A dead beneficiary cannot choose or gain.

An actual Lianju gain is marked only while the issuer has Silv; an actual Silv draw is marked at payment before children. A mark follows the exact physical card across transfers, uses, reshuffles, issuer skill loss and issuer death. Duplicate marking cannot create multiple refunds. No unrelated new damage draw is offered after source loss.

Only a native classified discard whose completion enters the discard pile refunds to the actual losing owner, including two-stage Processing discard provenance. Ordinary use cleanup, recast, equipment replacement, judgment finish, death cleanup, transfer and arbitrary discard-pile moves do not qualify. The exact still-available entity and latest discard receipt are required. Each entity per native movement sequence refunds once, and gain children finish before the original parent resumes.
Mark lookup is pure. Only cards already visible in a viewer-safe native snapshot receive the skill label. Hidden drawn-card mark facts remain trusted audit data and never disclose foreign hand IDs.
